question: What is the meaning of share of recycling at end-of-life in relation to material layers, materials?
description: The share of recycling at end-of-life refers to the proportion of materials that can be reused or recycled when a building is demolished or refurbished. This indicator assesses the circularity of materials by evaluating the ratio of recyclable or reusable materials to waste materials generated during the end-of-life phase of a building. In the context of material layers and materials, this indicator helps to identify opportunities for material reuse and recycling, promoting a more circular economy in construction.
